title: Convert uniform logical-qubit trace error to reference-safe diamond error
statement: For a qubit channel Lambda with sup_states ||Lambda(rho)-rho||1<=u, the unhalved diamond norm satisfies ||Lambda-id||diamond<=3u. In any Schmidt basis, diagonal images cost at most u in total and polarization bounds each off-diagonal image by2u, so an arbitrary pure entangled state costs u+4u sqrt(lambda(1-lambda))<=3u; convexity and channel discrimination finish the proof. Applied to ideal decoded storage, it supplies a reference-safe conversion, not perturbation robustness or noisy boundary preparation.
